manifesto.title: THE TRENCHES
paragraphs: Loop Gaiden is a comic universe inspired by the chaos of modern markets — crypto, stocks, Wall Street, memes, hype, fear, greed, wins, losses and the people caught in the middle of it all.
Every issue takes inspiration from the narratives, characters and madness moving the markets right now.

One week it might be a memecoin frenzy.

The next, a stock everyone suddenly cannot stop talking about.

An IPO.
A short squeeze.
An AI narrative.
A market crash.
A rotation nobody saw coming.
Through Loop, those moments become stories.
statements:
THE MARKET WRITES THE HEADLINES.
THE TRENCHES TURN THEM INTO STORIES. ♾️

mission.title: THE STORY MOVES WITH THE MARKET
mission.body: The markets never stay still. Neither does Loop Gaiden.

chapters.title: THE STORY MOVES WITH THE MARKET
chapters.body: Future stories can move through memecoin mania, Wall Street chaos, stock-market euphoria, crashes, squeezes, launches, IPOs, hype cycles, traders, influencers, communities and whatever narrative takes over next. Nothing needs to fit inside one fixed saga. If people are talking about it in the markets, it can inspire a Loop Gaiden story.
chapters.callout: THE MARKET NEVER STOPS. NEITHER DO THE STORIES. ∞

chapters.title: MARKET MOMENT → COMIC STORY
chapters.body: Loop Gaiden takes the culture, characters and narratives moving through the markets and transforms them into fictional comic stories. The goal is not to report the market. The goal is to turn its madness into stories.
items: 01 — THE MARKET MOVES: A new narrative captures everyone's attention.
02 — THE TRENCHES REACT: Traders, communities and the internet turn it into culture.
03 — LOOP ENTERS THE STORY: That moment becomes a new Loop Gaiden chapter.
chapters.callout: CRYPTO. STOCKS. WALL STREET. MEMES. MARKET PSYCHOLOGY. INTERNET CULTURE.

chapters.title: ONE CHARACTER. INFINITE STORIES.
chapters.body: Loop moves through the shadows of the market. Different cities. Different narratives. Different characters. Different battles. But the trenches are always there. The world around Loop can change with each issue while his identity remains constant. He is the thread connecting every story.
chapters.callout: THE MARKET CHANGES. LOOP KEEPS MOVING. ∞

community.title: THE COMMUNITY IS PART OF THE STORY
community.body:
Loop Gaiden is built around the culture of the trenches.

The memes. The theories. The wins. The losses. The ridiculous moments. The stories traders remember.

The community can help surface the narratives, characters and moments worth turning into future issues.

THE TRENCHES DON'T JUST WATCH THE STORY.
THEY LIVE IN IT.
